items.title: Demolish the unauthorised horse shelter
items.quote: Herr Korbinian Beispielmaier wird verpflichtet, den auf dem Grundstück Fl.-Nr. 1187/2 der Gemarkung Mustervils errichteten Pferdeunterstand (Holzbau, 8,00 m × 4,50 m, mit Bodenplatte) bis spätestens 05.01.2028 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The Bescheid itself fixes a calendar date for compliance ('bis spätestens 05.01.2028'), so no statutory period or deemed-delivery calculation is needed — the date is as printed. Checked the weekday and the Bavarian public holidays for January 2028: 05.01.2028 is a Wednesday and is not a holiday (Heilige Drei Könige falls on 06.01.2028, a Thursday, the day after). No weekend/holiday shift applies, so the deadline stands as stated.

items.title: File Klage against the Bescheid at the Verwaltungsgericht Musterhut
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage erhoben werden bei dem Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterhut, Hausanschrift: Gerichtsplatz 3, 84028 Musterhut.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 28.10.2027, sent by ordinary post by a Bavarian authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (and the parallel Art. 41 BayVwVfG), a letter posted by an authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Monday 01.11.2027 — this deemed-delivery day does not shift even though it is a public holiday (Allerheiligen) in Bayern. Counting of the one-month period then starts the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. from 01.11.2027. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the start day's eve, giving 01.12.2027. Wednesday 01.12.2027 is a normal working day in Bayern, so no further shift is needed. Confirmed with the ordnung_rules compute_deadline tool.

warnings: If the demolition ordered under Nr. 1 is not completed by 05.01.2028, a Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) of €1,500 becomes due under Nr. 2 of the Bescheid; no separate date for this payment is given in the letter, as it only applies in case of non-compliance.

The letter itself states that filing a legal remedy by ordinary e-mail is not permitted and has no legal effect ('Die Einlegung eines Rechtsbehelfs per einfacher E-Mail ist nicht zugelassen und entfaltet keine rechtlichen Wirkungen.') — any Klage must be filed with the Verwaltungsgericht in a legally valid form (post, in person, or qualified electronic filing).
A separate decision on the costs of this procedure is still to come ('Über die Kosten dieses Verfahrens ergeht ein gesonderter Bescheid.') — no amount or date for that is yet known.

The printed IBAN (DE49 7435 0000 0009 6100 00) checks out as a valid German IBAN for a Sparkasse, consistent with the sender; it is general office account information printed in the letter's footer, not a specific payment request on this page — still confirm via the Landratsamt's official channels before sending any money if the separate cost notice later asks for payment.
